corel_ask.speaker: corel
corel_ask.text: They want a demonstration of confidence. Tell them the containment method is proven. It nearly is. It will be.

choices.text: It isn't proven. I won't say it is.
I'll tell them what they need to hear.
I can frame the uncertainty as opportunity - honest and fundable both.
The Conclave doesn't fund certainty. It funds leverage. Let me show you what they actually want to buy.

truth.speaker: corel
truth.text: Then we may lose the funding, and the surges won't wait for our honesty.

choices.text: Better a lost grant than a lie in the foundation.
...Give me one week to make it true instead.

truth_end.speaker: corel
truth_end.text: As you say. I'll tell them the truth, and brace for it.

truth_week.speaker: corel
truth_week.text: One week. Make me a liar the honest way.

lie.speaker: corel
lie.text: Thank you. I know what it costs you.

lie_end.speaker: corel
lie_end.text: It's done. The first crack, laid in the foundation.

hedge_check.speaker: corel
hedge_check.text: ...That might actually hold. Draft it. Both of us sign.

hedge_fail.speaker: corel
hedge_fail.text: A pretty phrase, but the Conclave will see straight through it. We need a real answer.

choices.text: ...Fine. Tell them what they want to hear.

harmonist.speaker: corel
harmonist.text: You frighten me a little, Elorin. Do it.
